purpose: Illustrative ENT department photography for ent.html; subjects are fictional.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: ENT department website hero photograph for an Indian hospital, one standalone image, landscape 4:3 composition.
Primary request: A compassionate Indian female ENT clinician in her late 30s in a clean white coat over muted navy scrubs, performing a routine ear examination with a handheld black otoscope on a relaxed adult Indian male patient wearing a pale blue shirt. Both are fictional illustrative people, not a portrait of any real doctor.
Scene/backdrop: A bright, tidy contemporary ENT consulting room, a softly blurred diagnostic workstation in the background, white walls with subtle navy blue and muted sage green accents.
Composition/framing: Medium close-up from the side, clinician on the left facing the patient on the right, both faces and the otoscope clearly visible within the middle 75 percent of the frame. Otoscope positioned naturally at the external ear, realistic instrument and hands. Clinician and patient's eye level similar. Leave comfortable margins for responsive crops. No text overlay space needed.
Style/medium: Premium natural editorial healthcare photography, lifelike skin texture, credible Indian clinical environment, gentle daylight, reassuring and professional mood, restrained color grading.
Constraints: Routine external ear exam only, anatomically plausible hands and equipment, clean uncluttered scene, no blood or surgery, no logos, no name badges, no writing, no labels, no watermarks, no collages.

Use case: photorealistic-natural

Keep both faces and headphones within middle 75 percent of frame with comfortable margins for a near-square crop.
Style/medium: Natural editorial healthcare photograph matching a premium hospital website, gentle daylight, realistic skin textures and fabrics, warm reassuring expression, professional calm atmosphere.
Constraints: No real identifiable doctor, no logos, no name badges, no readable screen text, no writing or watermarks, no surgery, no blood, no collage, no exaggerated smiles, anatomically natural hands and headphones.
